description: Canonical tomato-bazel distribution dependency versions — the BOM. The `rels deps` ratchet audits every repo's MODULE.bazel against this and opens coordinated bumps; repos should not float below these. This is a manifest (data), NOT transitive bazel_deps, so consuming rules_tomato doesn't pull the whole constellation.

notes.aspect_rules_js: 3.1.2 — 17 modules are already here; one is on 2.1.3, which the ratchet will bump. That is a MAJOR move, so verify that repo before merging its bump PR.
notes.brand: Bump to 0.3.0 once the @brand//mdbook:theme release lands (0.2.0 is the last published).
notes.googleapis: Pseudo-version (0.0.0-<date>-<sha>). Ordering is by the prerelease segment, so a newer snapshot sorts above; bump deliberately, not by ratchet.
notes.rules_cc: Pinned at 0.0.17; 0.2.x is a coordinated MAJOR bump (verify per repo first), not auto-ratcheted.
notes.rules_ci: Renamed from rules_ci_ir; key it here once Agent-A publishes the first registry version.
notes.rules_proto_grpc: The three rules_proto_grpc* modules move together at 5.8.0 — bumping one alone breaks codegen.
notes.rules_python: Held at 1.7.0 — Agent-A's rules_gitlab 0.3.2 toolchain wants it; a 2.x move is a later coordinated bump (re-verify rules_gitlab first).
